# Dilemma v3.0.2

- Ask quiz generation to omit unnecessary traits, wordplay and other unintended hints, including answer-revealing titles and emoji.
- Include the platypus/porcupine example: test electroreception without also revealing the animal's beak.
- Ask for plausible alternatives with parallel grammar and comparable detail while preserving custom answer text/order and the requested difficulty.
- Send shared instructions once, without adding another AI review request. Keep the model, output schema, token limits and retry budget unchanged.
- Extend synthetic request regressions and update README guidance. These checks verify the request contract, not live-model question quality; prompt instructions do not guarantee hint-free or factually correct questions.

No database migration or Discord command re-registration is required from v3.0.1. Existing quiz messages are unchanged; the updated instructions apply to newly generated questions.
